title: Headless TTW Free Labor (DLC01Quest03), Ashur's side: from the player's gear by the Hole through Haven, Ashur's offer and the riot's call, Sandra and the cure, Midea's word on Wernher and the fight in his hideout back to Ashur (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Starts with the player out of Vault 101 (the given): Escape! (CG04) done at stage 200, whose script starts Following in His Footsteps (MQ01 stage 10) and Trouble on the Homefront (MS16). [observed: CG04 stage 200 script] Then Unsafe Working Conditions done (the given, as ttw-dlc01quest02-unsafe-working-conditions leaves it): the player won the three fights in the Hole and Krenshaw's line set DLC01Quest02 200, whose stage script set this quest's stage 0 (Retrieve your gear; Ashur waits in Haven). This chain takes Ashur's side: the player leaves the baby with Sandra and stops Wernher (stage 200, path A).

The player's gear, stripped at the gate, waits in the return container by the Hole (stage 170 of Unsafe Working Conditions moved it there); opening it (DLC01PlayerItemContainer02SCRIPT, TTW's [observed]) sets stage 5 (travel through Uptown to Haven).

The given leaves the Hole's gate (DLC01HoleGateREF) as the last fight's start locked it (INFO 0x0C0032C8's begin script: Lock 255); the talk after the win, which the given does not play, unlocks it (INFO 0x0C0032D5's and 0x0C007148's end scripts [observed]: DLC01HoleGateREF.Unlock). Stand-in for that line's end script.

The given does not run the stage scripts that open the way from Downtown to the scaffolds and Haven: DLC01DowntownGateToScaffoldsREF is unlocked by Unsafe Working Conditions' stage 200 and by Free Labor's stage 0 (their result scripts [observed]: DLC01DowntownGateToScaffoldsREF.Unlock). Stand-in for them.
Travel stand-in: through Uptown into Haven; the trigger inside (DLC01HavenInsideTriggerSCRIPT [observed]) sets stage 10 (talk to Ashur on the top floor).

actions.label: ashur: nice work in the hole, new blood
I heard you're looking for help

actions.text: Ashur's last line hails the intercom (its end script: DLC01AshurIntercomREF.Say DLC01AshurCalledOutside1); the intercom's line (begin script: stage 20, the riot) links to Ashur's answer, whose end script has him tell the player, leaving, to see Sandra (DLC01AshurLeavingToPlayer, its end script: stage 22). Engine gap: the intercom (a talking activator, base DLC01AshurIntercom) says nothing in this headless run ('no_line' [observed]), so its line and Ashur's linked answer are said with say_info as the stand-in.

actions.label: sandra: Ashur told me you might be coming
Ashur said you could show me a cure (stage 30)
milestone: DLC01Quest03 30, the baby is the cure

actions.text: The player leaves Marie in her crib and walks out of Haven: the door (DLC01AshurDoorScript2 [observed]: at stage 30 without the baby) sets stage 50, Ashur's side; the slaves turn on the player and Wernher hides in the Steelyard.

actions.label: milestone: DLC01Quest03 50, find out from Midea where Wernher is

actions.text: Travel stand-in: back to Midea's quarters (stage 50 moves her there).

actions.label: midea: you signed on with Ashur
where is Wernher: a Speech challenge, passed in this run (stage 70)

actions.text: Travel stand-in: to the Steelyard's blast furnace and Wernher's hideout (DLC01WernherHideout).

actions.label: I'm not giving you the baby

actions.text: Stand-in for the fight with Wernher: the player kills him (DC01WernerSCRIPT's OnDeath, TTW's [observed]: with objective 50 shown, stage 100).
Travel stand-in: back up to Haven, where stage 100 has put Ashur (DLC01TP03AshurPlayerWait).

actions.label: ashur: I knew I could trust you
